summary: Iteration 5 testing complete. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests pass (no regression from iter 4). Frontend: Discover runtime error FIXED and renders fully (Hi+greeting, search bento, chips, Featured carousel, All sets). /settings route works (settings-light/dark/back all functional; dark mode toggles). theme-toggle correctly removed from Wallet. Quiz option testIDs work and reveal green/blue states. HOWEVER three iteration-5 visual specs were NOT fully implemented in the shipped code: (b) wallet redemption redesign missing (no 4th tier 'redeem-1200', tiles still old rectangular 342x80 rows, no horizontal swipe, no square 266x220 cards, no in-card Redeem button pattern); (d) home blue gradient balance card not rendered — LinearGradient is imported but never used in JSX, pointsCard has no background (appears transparent/dark); (c) home title uses fontWeight '800' (spec: 600) and has no maxWidth:260 so 'Let's learn something new' overflows to the right edge on 390px viewport. Quiz option cards are height 160px (spec: min 210px) — minor. These are shipped-code gaps, not test-environment issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Iteration 5 redesign NOT shipped. Missing testID 'redeem-1200' (only 150/300/600 rendered). Tiles are still the OLD vertical rectangular rows (rendered 342x80) instead of horizontally-swipable large rounded square cards (spec: width 266, min-height 220) with in-card Redeem button. Confirmed in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx lines 97-116 — hardcoded 3-item array [{150},{300},{600}] in a plain map, no horizontal ScrollView, no big-tile styles.

Blue grainy LinearGradient (#6EA8FF→#2F5BFF→#1E3A8A) from spec (d) is NOT rendered. LinearGradient is imported at line 5 but never used in the JSX tree. The pointsCard style (lines 204-207) has NO backgroundColor set, so the card body is transparent and only the translucent dark pointsInner panel is visible — giving a grey/dark appearance instead of the intended blue gradient. Also no dotted grain overlay (the 'grain' style at line 208 is defined but never mounted).

Spec (c) says fontWeight 600 with maxWidth 260 so 'Let's learn something new' wraps to two lines. Actual style (line 202): fontWeight '800', fontSize 28, no maxWidth. Result: title renders on a single line and overflows past the right edge on 390px viewport (visible in screenshot /tmp/03_home.png).

Spec (a) says min-height 210px for quiz option cards. Measured actual height: 160px for all 4 options. Functionality (black idle, blue selected, green correct reveal, next button) works correctly — only the height is off.

issues: Balance card is visually grey/dark, not the blue brand gradient spec intended.
Header title overflows screen width due to missing maxWidth.
Redemption tiles still use the pre-iteration-5 layout; visual hierarchy intended for 'one tile ~ size of 3 old rectangular ones combined' is not achieved.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning repeats: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — carried over from iteration 4, still not migrated.

action_items: Wallet: implement the iteration-5 redemption tile redesign. Replace the 3-item map in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx (lines 97-116) with a horizontal ScrollView of 4 large rounded square TouchableOpacity tiles (width 266, min-height 220) for tiers 150/300/600/1200; add testIDs redeem-150, redeem-300, redeem-600, redeem-1200; each tile should show locked/unlocked badge, big minutes title, points subtitle and an in-card Redeem button.

Home: wrap the pointsCard contents in a <LinearGradient colors={['#6EA8FF','#2F5BFF','#1E3A8A']} start={{x:0,y:0}} end={{x:1,y:1}} style={s.pointsCard}> and mount the dotted grain overlay (the s.grain style is defined but never used). Currently LinearGradient is imported but unused.
Home: set title fontWeight to '600' (not '800') and add maxWidth: 260 on s.title so 'Let's learn something new' wraps to two lines instead of overflowing.
Quiz: bump minHeight of quiz option cards to 210 (currently renders 160) to match spec (a) — functionality is otherwise correct.
(Carried over from iter 4) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow in app/index.tsx for React Native Web compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx: LinearGradient is imported (line 5) but not rendered anywhere — dead import masking an un-implemented feature. Lint should flag unused imports.
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx: 'grain' style (line 208) is defined but never mounted in the JSX tree — same situation; suggests partial implementation was merged.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx: the redemption tier array is hardcoded inline (line 97); moving it to a module-level constant with all 4 tiers (150/300/600/1200) would have made the spec deviation obvious at PR time.
server.py remains ~655 lines; splitting quiz/flashcard/social routers is still recommended but non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: Functional testIDs: 9/10 present (redeem-1200 missing). Visual specs: 3 of 6 iteration-5 items implemented as described (discover fix, settings route, theme-toggle removal). 3 items partially/not implemented (wallet redesign, home gradient, home title weight+maxWidth).

rca_of_issue: Wallet redemption redesign (spec b) and Home blue-gradient balance card (spec d) appear to have been specified in the prompt but never materially implemented in the commit: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx still uses the old three-row rectangular layout without the 1200-tier, and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx imports LinearGradient + defines a 'grain' style but never mounts either in the JSX. Home title weight (spec c) shipped at '800' instead of '600' and missed the maxWidth:260, causing visible overflow. These are classic 'commit dropped the JSX changes but kept the imports' symptoms — likely a bad merge/rebase. Reproduction: open /wallet and compare rendered tiles vs the four-tile horizontal swipe described in the problem statement; open /home and inspect the pointsCard — it has no gradient background. Mitigation: apply the four action items listed above.
